title: #086. Rolling-Horizon Planning (MPC)
subtitle: Execute Model Predictive Control over sliding forecast windows, committing only period t before observing actual demand.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { produced, inventories, shortfalls, totalCost }.
judge.m2: inventories[{p0}] ({p1}) does not match realized inventory balance ({p2}).
judge.m3: shortfalls[{p0}] ({p1}) does not match realized demand shortfall ({p2}).
judge.m4: Reported totalCost ({p0}) does not match accumulated realized cost ({p1}).
judge.m5: Realized cost ({p0}) deviates below the rolling-horizon MPC cost ({p1}); check that each step plans only over windowLen using forecastDemands.
judge.m6: Realized cost ({p0}) exceeds the rolling-horizon MPC cost ({p1}).
judge.m8: Period {p0} action produced[{p0}] = {p1} is not optimal for the {p0}-th forecast window (window cost {p2} vs optimum {p3}).
